entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Thomas de Mahy, Marquis de Favras, was a French aristocrat and supporter of the House of Bourbon during the French Revolution. Often seen as a martyr of the Royalist cause, Favras was executed for his part in "planning against the people of France" under the Count of Provence.
